title: BGS pilot — shared definitions
description: Only invariant tokens are centralised here; context-specific sentinels are inlined per field because their meanings differ by variable.

not_applicable.title: Not applicable
not_applicable.description: The derivation is structurally inapplicable for this participant (for example too young at baseline, pregnant, or never had a live birth). Distinct from missing_numeric, which means no valid value could be derived. Adopted from the source's own 9999 code, D003.

missing_numeric.title: Missing
missing_numeric.description: No valid value was derived. Replaces the source's bare null (source wording: 'Missing or invalid', 'Unknown', 'Left blank'). Agent-proposed code, steward-approved 2026-09-21, D004.

participant_id.title: Pseudo-anonymized 8-character study identifier.
participant_id.$comment: Source: type string, minLength 8, maxLength 8. The source states no character set, so the pattern only fixes the length (D017).
